description: Land Acquisition - Karagoda, Uyangoda, Kamburupitiya D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain described land is needed for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed land descriptions, boundaries, and extents in a specific location (Karagoda-Uyangoda village), which falls squarely under the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities that would make it a Hybrid type.
